answer: Tie each identity to a continuous work pulse: before an agent can vote or trade, it must lock a refundable capital bond and then keep emitting rate-limited, signed proofs of real compute at a fixed cadence. One honest operator pays a single bond and sustains one pulse; a sybil flooding the ocean of fake accounts must fund a separate bond for every clone and grind every clone's pulse in parallel, so attacker cost scales linearly with identity count. Lapsed pulses decay standing, so a dormant bond becomes a worthless relic rather than cheap voting weight.
